ai_instructions: Warm, plain-language clinic intake for AccelHealth (Brownwood). Ask the preferred language first, then proceed in that language. Group related questions naturally, confirm spelling of names and addresses, and reassure the patient that demographic and optional questions can be skipped. Skip the parent/guardian section entirely for adult patients.

fields.label: Preferred Language
fields.ai_note: Ask this FIRST. The form itself only records English / Spanish / Other; if 'Other', continue in English.
fields.question: Before we begin — what language would you like to use?

fields.label: First Name
fields.question: What is your first name?

fields.label: Last Name
fields.question: And your last name?

fields.label: Middle Name
fields.question: What is your middle name? Just skip this if you don't have one.

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.ai_note: Used to auto-fill the AGE field and to decide whether the guardian section applies.
fields.question: What is your date of birth?

fields.label: Social Security Number
fields.question: What is your Social Security Number? This is optional — you can skip it if you prefer.

fields.label: Mailing Address
fields.question: What is your mailing address — the street and number?

fields.label: Apt No
fields.question: What is your apartment or unit number? Skip this if you don't have one.

fields.label: City
fields.question: What city do you live in?

fields.label: State
fields.question: Which state?

fields.label: ZIP
fields.question: And your ZIP code?

fields.label: County
fields.question: What county is that in?

fields.label: Cell Phone
fields.question: What's the best cell phone number to reach you?

fields.label: Home Phone
fields.question: What is your home phone number? Skip this if you don't have one.

fields.label: Work Phone
fields.question: What is your work phone number? Skip this if you don't have one.

fields.label: Emergency Contact
fields.question: Who should we contact in an emergency? Please give a name and phone number.

fields.label: Agricultural work — intro
fields.question: The next three questions help the clinic serve farm-working families. Please answer yes or no.

fields.label: Worked in agriculture (last 2 years)
fields.question: In the last 2 years, have you or anyone in your family done farm work — like planting, picking, preparing soil, packing, driving a farm truck, or working with animals?

fields.label: Lived away from home for agricultural work
fields.question: In the last 2 years, have you or a family member lived away from home in order to do agricultural work?

fields.label: Stopped migrating for agriculture due to disability
fields.question: Have you or a family member stopped traveling for agricultural work because of a disability?

fields.label: Demographics — intro
fields.question: Now a few questions about identity and background. These help the clinic provide better care, and you can skip any of them.

fields.label: Birth Sex
fields.question: What sex were you assigned at birth?

fields.label: Current Gender
fields.question: What is your current gender?

fields.label: Gender Identity
fields.ai_note: Optional. The form marks this section optional for patients under 18.
fields.question: How do you describe your gender identity? Feel free to skip.

fields.label: Sexual Orientation
fields.ai_note: Optional. The form marks this section optional for patients under 18.
fields.question: How do you describe your sexual orientation? Feel free to skip.

fields.label: Preferred Pronoun
fields.question: What are your preferred pronouns?

fields.label: Race
options: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander
fields.question: Which best describes your race? You can choose more than one.

fields.label: Ethnicity
fields.question: How would you describe your ethnicity?

fields.label: Marital Status
fields.question: What is your marital status?

fields.label: U.S. Veteran
fields.question: Are you a U.S. veteran?

fields.label: Homeless Status
fields.ai_note: 'Doubling Up' means staying with friends or family. Map gently and without judgment.
fields.question: What best describes your current housing situation?

fields.label: How did you hear about AccelHealth?
fields.question: How did you hear about AccelHealth? You can pick more than one.

fields.label: Primary Insurance Name
fields.question: What is your primary insurance, if you have one? Skip if you don't.

fields.label: Secondary Insurance Name
fields.question: What is your secondary insurance? Skip this if you don't have one.

fields.label: May leave detailed phone messages
fields.question: May we leave detailed phone messages for you?

fields.label: May mail detailed correspondence
fields.question: May we mail detailed correspondence to your address?

fields.label: May text important reminders
fields.question: May we text you important reminders?

fields.label: May email information
fields.question: May we email you information?

fields.label: Patient is a minor
fields.ai_note: If 'No', skip the entire parent/guardian section. Not applicable for family planning services.
fields.question: Is the patient under 18 years old?

fields.label: Parent/Guardian #1 Name
fields.question: What is the parent or guardian's full name?

fields.label: Relationship to child
fields.question: What is their relationship to the patient?

fields.label: Guardian #1 same address as patient
fields.question: Does this guardian live at the same address as the patient?

fields.label: Guardian #1 City/State/Zip
fields.question: What is the guardian's address (city, state, ZIP)?

fields.label: Guardian #1 Date of Birth
fields.question: What is the guardian's date of birth?

fields.label: Guardian #1 Cell Phone
fields.question: What is the guardian's cell phone number?

fields.label: Guardian #1 Home Phone
fields.question: What is the guardian's home phone number? Skip if they don't have one.

fields.label: Guardian #1 Work Phone
fields.question: What is the guardian's work phone number? Skip if they don't have one.

fields.label: Guardian #1 Employer
fields.question: Who is the guardian's employer? Skip this if it doesn't apply.

fields.label: Guardian #1 SSN
fields.question: What is the guardian's Social Security Number? This is optional.

fields.label: Add second guardian
fields.question: Is there a second parent or guardian to add?

fields.label: Parent/Guardian #2 Name
fields.question: What is the second guardian's full name?

fields.label: Relationship to child (2)
fields.question: What is their relationship to the patient?

fields.label: Guardian #2 same address as patient
fields.question: Does the second guardian live at the same address as the patient?

fields.label: Guardian #2 City/State/Zip
fields.question: What is the second guardian's address (city, state, ZIP)?

fields.label: Guardian #2 Date of Birth
fields.question: What is the second guardian's date of birth?

fields.label: Guardian #2 Cell Phone
fields.question: What is the second guardian's cell phone number?

fields.label: Guardian #2 Home Phone
fields.question: What is the second guardian's home phone number? Skip if they don't have one.

fields.label: Guardian #2 Work Phone
fields.question: What is the second guardian's work phone number? Skip if they don't have one.

fields.label: Guardian #2 Employer
fields.question: Who is the second guardian's employer? Skip this if it doesn't apply.

fields.label: Guardian #2 SSN
fields.question: What is the second guardian's Social Security Number? This is optional.

fields.label: Consent — intro
fields.question: Almost done. By signing, you authorize the release of information and accept financial responsibility as described on the form.

fields.label: Patient or Authorized Signature
fields.question: Please sign below to complete your registration.
